deployments_detail.use: Seven West Media (SGH-associated media business) established the 'Seven AI Factory', a dedicated generative AI and machine learning team partnered with Databricks, embedded in Seven's Sydney offices, building audience prediction models that forecast video-on-demand audience by show and genre for the next 28 days to drive content relevance and personalisation across 7plus and 7NEWS. [Databricks]
deployments_detail.value: 94% accuracy forecasting VOD audience by show/genre over next 28 days

deployments_detail.use: WesTrac, with Thiess and Caterpillar, deployed Cat MineStar Command for drilling (autonomous drilling) at the Mt Arthur South coal operation in NSW, running three Cat MD-series drills controlled remotely by a single operator, reaching one million metres drilled autonomously in production. [Caterpillar (Cat MineStar Command)]
deployments_detail.value: 1,000,000 metres drilled autonomously; 20% improvement in drilling performance; up to 8% fuel reduction; drill utilisation up to 23 hours/day

deployments_detail.use: WesTrac supplies and supports Cat MineStar Command for hauling autonomous haulage systems for Fortescue's Pilbara mines; Cloudbreak became the first remote mining operation in the world to run Cat MineStar Command in production mode, with an autonomous fleet scaling to 175 trucks including first multi-class (Cat and Komatsu) autonomous haulage. [Caterpillar (Cat MineStar Command); WesTrac (support)]
deployments_detail.value: 38 autonomous Cat 789D trucks at Cloudbreak scaling to 175 trucks; fleet moved 860M+ tonnes, 30% productivity improvement

deployments_detail.use: WesTrac provides Cat MineStar Health for real-time equipment condition monitoring and predictive analytics, enabling early detection and intervention on potential equipment issues; the Cat MineStar Edge cloud platform delivers near-real-time data reported as up to 98% accurate. [Caterpillar (Cat MineStar Health / Edge)]
deployments_detail.value: MineStar Edge data up to 98% accurate

deployments_detail.use: Coates (SGH's equipment rental business) operates SiteIQ, a next-generation asset management platform providing real-time visibility and telemetry across tools, equipment, consumables and services, alongside drone-based asset inspection services, to improve on-site productivity and safety for customers. [none]

WesTrac (SGH's Caterpillar dealership) runs an AutoStore automated parts warehouse at its Tomago NSW distribution centre, using 24 AI-powered robots with memory-based AI to locate and retrieve stored parts, picking up to 500 product lines per hour and completing orders in 5-10 minutes, operating 24/7. [AutoStore (AI-powered robots)]
deployments_detail.value: 500 product lines picked per hour; order retrieval in 5-10 minutes; 1,000 sqm of space added

deployments_detail.use: SGH's FY25 annual report describes enterprise-wide transformation programs across WesTrac, Coates and Boral including 'Digital Customer Experience (Phase 2)' and a 'Data & Analytics' program to improve customer visibility and decision-making across the industrial services businesses. [none]

Seven West Media deployed 'Phoenix', its total-TV trading/revenue platform that uses inventory optimisation and AI audience prediction engines to drive programmatic and addressable advertising sales across its broadcast and 7plus inventory. [none]

[Caterpillar (Cat MineStar Detect / Driver Safety System)]
